title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Gemini Labs Site…
description: A Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Gemini Labs Site Reviews up to version 8.3.7. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute in users' browsers. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 score of 7.1, indicating a high severity level.
